newsitem.title: USA: Polaroid launches new projector models.
newsitem.headline: Polaroid launches new projector models.

text.p: Polaroid Corp said on Tuesday that it added two new projector models to its line of electronic presentation products, the Polaview 220 digital light processing projector and the Polaview 305 high-resolution LCD projector.

The Polaview 220 incorporates new digital light processing technology developed by Texas Instruments Inc, which includes a digital micro-mirror device light engine which enables the unit to deliver brighter color images on-screen, it said.
No further details were immediately available.
